title: 中国哲学（三）：荀子的思想
subtitle: Chinese Philosophy III · The Thought of Xunzi

cards.example: 荀子是战国末期的重要思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi was an important thinker at the end of the Warring States period.
cards.breakdown: 荀：像树枝一样分叉的事物 · 子：称呼人的后缀，表示先生或有学问的人

cards.example: 荀子继承了孔子的儒家思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi inherited the Confucian thought of Confucius.
cards.breakdown: 儒：讲究礼仪和仁德的人 · 家：学派、门派的意思

cards.back: the theory that human nature is evil
cards.example: 荀子提出了性恶论。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi proposed the theory that human nature is evil.
cards.breakdown: 性：人的本性 · 恶：不好的方面 · 论：理论、见解

cards.pinyin: míng yú tiān rén zhī fēn
cards.back: to understand the distinction between heaven/nature and human beings
cards.example: 荀子强调要明于天人之分。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi emphasized understanding the distinction between heaven and human beings.
cards.breakdown: 明：看清楚 · 天：自然界 · 人：人类自身 · 分：区分、界限

cards.example: 荀子认为人性本恶。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi believed that human nature is fundamentally evil.
cards.breakdown: 人：人类 · 性：本性、天性

cards.back: artificial; false; what is made by human effort
cards.example: 人之性恶，其善者伪也。
cards.exampleTranslation: Human nature is evil; what is good is the result of human effort.
cards.breakdown: 伪：人为制造出来的，不是天生的

cards.example: 人生来就有各种欲望。
cards.exampleTranslation: People are born with many desires.
cards.breakdown: 欲：想要、追求 · 望：希望、期待

cards.example: 人会为自己追求利益。
cards.exampleTranslation: People seek benefits for themselves.
cards.breakdown: 利：利益、好处 · 益：增加、有益

cards.example: 求利的本能是人性的表现之一。
cards.exampleTranslation: The instinct to seek profit is one expression of human nature.
cards.breakdown: 本：本来、天生 · 能：能力、力量

cards.example: 治理国家不能只靠爱心，还要靠制度。
cards.exampleTranslation: To govern a country, one cannot rely only on love; one also needs systems.
cards.breakdown: 制：规定、约束 · 度：标准、尺度

cards.example: 完善的法规能约束人的行为。
cards.exampleTranslation: Good laws and regulations can restrain people's behavior.
cards.breakdown: 法：法则、法律 · 规：规则、准则

cards.example: 自然界是有规律地运动变化的。
cards.exampleTranslation: The natural world moves and changes according to its own laws.
cards.breakdown: 自：自身 · 然：自然、应当如此 · 界：范围、边界

cards.example: 自然界有自己的运行规律。
cards.exampleTranslation: Nature has its own laws of operation.
cards.breakdown: 规：规则 · 律：法度、节律

cards.example: 自然界的运动并没有什么目的。
cards.exampleTranslation: The movement of nature has no purpose.
cards.breakdown: 目：眼睛看到的目标 · 的：定语标记 · 目的：想要达到的目标

cards.example: 自然界中的万物互相联系。
cards.exampleTranslation: Everything in nature is interconnected.
cards.breakdown: 联：连接在一起 · 系：系统、关联

cards.example: 要分清什么是自然界的性质和功能。
cards.exampleTranslation: One should distinguish the nature and function of the natural world.
cards.breakdown: 性：本性 · 质：本质、性质

cards.example: 自然界的功能就是使万物自然生长。
cards.exampleTranslation: The function of nature is to let all things grow naturally.
cards.breakdown: 功：功劳、作用 · 能：能力

cards.example: 人生来就有理性。
cards.exampleTranslation: People are born with reason.
cards.breakdown: 理：道理、条理 · 性：本性

cards.back: to reform; to transform; to remake
cards.example: 人能认识自然、利用自然、改造自然。
cards.exampleTranslation: Humans can understand nature, use nature, and transform nature.
cards.breakdown: 改：修改 · 造：制造、建立

cards.example: 人能组织成群体，形成社会。
cards.exampleTranslation: People can organize into groups and form society.
cards.breakdown: 组：分组 · 织：编织、组织起来

cards.example: 社会是人类共同生活的组织形式。
cards.exampleTranslation: Society is the organized form of human collective life.
cards.breakdown: 社：土地神、祭祀 · 会：聚会、集会

cards.example: 集体的力量可以战胜自然。
cards.exampleTranslation: The power of the collective can overcome nature.
cards.breakdown: 集：聚合 · 体：整体、身体

cards.example: 人的力量并不是无限的。
cards.exampleTranslation: Human power is not infinite.
cards.breakdown: 无：没有 · 限：界限、限制

cards.example: 人不要企图改变自己不能改变的东西。
cards.exampleTranslation: People should not try to change what they cannot change.
cards.breakdown: 企：打算、谋划 · 图：谋划、计谋

cards.example: 荀子，名况，战国末期赵国人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xunzi, whose given name was Kuang, was a man from Zhao at the end of the Warring States period.
cards.breakdown: 名：名讳、名字 · 况：字名的字名 · 赵国：当时的国名
